title: Builder onboarding: /build hub + /join cleanup
reported_problem: Builders lacked a single practical entry point and consistent signup path.
requested_behavior: Unify onboarding and provide current resources for contracts, confidential AI, and agent commerce.
author: itexpert120

title: Email notifications for critical user events
reported_problem: Important approval decisions could be missed when users did not revisit the site.
requested_behavior: Send critical decisions to verified email addresses with a notification preference.
author: itexpert120

title: SSR: expose the design-system components from the node build
reported_problem: Sibling applications could not render the shared component library during server rendering.
requested_behavior: Expose the shared primitives from the server build and publish integrity information.
author: elliotBraem

title: Design-system export surface: complete the components barrel with all primitives
reported_problem: The exported component set was incomplete and mixed general primitives with application-specific controls.
requested_behavior: Provide a complete reusable component surface and separate application-specific pieces.
author: elliotBraem

title: Canonical style pass: shadcn lint all components + finalize styles.css
reported_problem: Hardcoded component colors made shared theming inconsistent.
requested_behavior: Use canonical semantic design tokens and check future changes for violations.
author: elliotBraem

title: Unlisted projects still appear in the public Projects directory
reported_problem: An author reported that an entry marked unlisted still appeared in public browsing.
requested_behavior: Exclude unlisted entries from directory results while keeping their direct links usable.
author: abdulahaddayater

title: Update website design system
reported_problem: The site needed a coordinated visual update rather than isolated component changes.
requested_behavior: Apply one selected design preset across components and routes.
author: itexpert120

title: Add "Request feedback" entry point on project pages linking to feedback.nearbuilders.org
reported_problem: Starting a feedback round required repeating information already attached to a project.
requested_behavior: Link the project page to the feedback service with the project preselected.
author: ayushsingh82

title: Brand section to the NearBuilders website
reported_problem: Contributors lacked a clear location for consistent logos, fonts, and visual assets.
requested_behavior: Publish accessible brand assets and derive them from maintained project definitions where practical.
author: elliotBraem

title: Feedback Rounds: standalone build for project-requested testing rounds
reported_problem: Projects needed a structured way to recruit testers and recognize useful feedback.
requested_behavior: Run bounded testing rounds, use existing GitHub issues, and attach contributor credit.
author: Skytonet2

title: Multi-language support (i18n) — add language selector, ship English + starter locales
reported_problem: A non-English-speaking tester lacked an explicit supported language choice.
requested_behavior: Offer maintained translations, a language selector, and a persistent locale preference.
author: Skytonet2

title: Activity feed: icons, color per activity type, per-type filters
reported_problem: Activity rows looked alike and were difficult to scan.
requested_behavior: Distinguish event categories visually and allow filtering by activity source.
author: Skytonet2

title: Perf: static assets cached for only 4 hours
reported_problem: An audit reported short caching periods for static assets.
requested_behavior: Use appropriate caching for versioned files and control locally served partner assets.
author: Skytonet2

title: SEO: listing pages serve empty HTML (client-only render)
reported_problem: Initial listing HTML omitted the entries that browsers later loaded.
requested_behavior: Render an initial group of records on the server for readers and indexing tools.
author: Skytonet2

title: SEO: Open Graph tags on listing pages fall back to homepage
reported_problem: Listing links used generic homepage sharing metadata.
requested_behavior: Generate titles, descriptions, and sharing URLs for the requested page.
author: Skytonet2

title: I want to change my wallet in Nearbuilder profile
reported_problem: A user wanted to replace the wallet associated with an existing profile.
requested_behavior: Support a deliberate change of linked account while retaining the profile.
author: Om7eth
